summary: Rank conditioning did not improve development NLL in this pilot. Both learned models had unresolved raw endings; data and profile support remain limited. Training had no 8k game sides and only one each at 5k, 13k and 14k.
prompt: Inspect a game ending and candidate pass flags for each arm in Games, then choose the next E2 data scope. Record any concerns about replay, scoring, or the proposed next step.

options.label: Build the cached corpus first (recommended)
options.detail: Finish the fixed remaining 2,135 source candidates, legally replay and deduplicate admitted records, preserve all existing cohorts and owner exclusions, and rebuild nonfinal examples with a train-only normalizer. Proposed ceiling: 6 CPU-hours and 8 elapsed hours, zero downloads or GPU work. Record actual row counts before any later SL recipe. This step does not qualify the rank range.

options.label: Prioritize a broader data proposal
options.detail: Prepare a bounded acquisition and cohort-extension proposal aimed at missing low ranks and held-out account support. Preserve current final reservations and record new request/compute limits before acquisition. No new download or model run follows from this choice alone.

options.label: Defer further E2 data and training
options.detail: Retain this pilot as a negative conditioning result and keep the saved models, reference and runner available. Leave baseline-readiness and raw-opponent qualification gates open where their prerequisites remain unmet.

coverage_audit.summary: A fixed URL prefix was checked before the time reserve stopped the audit: 2,134 attempted, 415 source-admitted, and 2,135 unattempted. Do not extrapolate this prefix to the remaining list.
coverage_audit.scope: Source-screening counts only: no new legal replay, trajectory deduplication, examples or profile qualification. Handle strings are not verified people. Existing and conservative new exposure registries must both be retained.
